blocks.content: To choose one query and open it, complete the following steps:

Set the time range to the period when the issue occurred.

Click the **Duration** column header until the queries that take the longest are at the top. If the table shows no data after the sort, change the sort or the time range and continue.

Click the **Errors** column header. If **Errors** is empty for every row, sort by **Duration** only and continue.

When more than one database is listed, open **Filters** and select the **instance** label, then one server. Within that server, select **schema** on MySQL, or **datname** on PostgreSQL.

Choose the query with the highest impact. Impact is the average duration multiplied by how often the query runs, and a short query that runs constantly can outweigh a long one that runs rarely. Whether the query is user-facing or on a critical path counts as well.

Click that query. Its details open.
The details of the query you chose are open.
